subject: Re: Procurement & PO process — WaveBank / Redwood
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@wavebank.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 15:08:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap + procurement next steps (WaveBank)

Hi Sanjay / Elena (looping Elena for visibility),

Thanks again for the call earlier — great to learn more about WaveBank's latency SLAs for fraud detection and how you prioritize procurement timelines. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary of decisions from call:
- Primary use case: real-time fraud scoring (sub-100ms 95th pct target) for transaction enrichment.
- Economic buyer: Elena Martinez (VP Product) — final approval for vendor + budget.
- Procurement contact: Sanjay Rao / procurement@wavebank.com, with standard vendor onboarding and PO.
- Security/compliance: WaveBank will run a security questionnaire; Redwood can provide SOC2, encryption docs, and a short security packet.

Immediate asks from your side:
1) Vendor onboarding form (procurement) — you mentioned a short vendor packet we should complete.
2) PO timing and billing cadence (net30 vs net45) and invoice routing.
3) Any specific contract redlines your legal team requires.

Proposed Redwood action items:
- I will attach our MSA (v1.2) and a vendor onboarding packet for your procurement team to review (see attachments).
- Stephanie will coordinate security artifacts (SOC 2 report, penetration-test summary) and provide within 48–72 hours.
- Neha (Finance) will confirm invoicing details & bank info once we have PO terms.

Suggested timeline (flexible):
- Day 0–3: Share redwood onboarding packet + security artifacts (we can do this by Mon 23 Feb).
- Day 3–10: WaveBank completes onboarding + security review.
- Day 10–30: PO issuance and start of technical ramp / sandbox access.

Next step: Sanjay — can you send the vendor onboarding form (or link) and confirm whether Net30 is standard for WaveBank? Also confirm if a physical PO is required or an emailed PO to finance is sufficient.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0186
https://redwoodinference.com

Attachments: redwood_ms_master_services_agreement_v1.2.pdf (MSA), invoice_instructions_and_bank_details.pdf (billing), wavebank_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (placeholder if you have a custom form, we'll fill)
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@wavebank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@wavebank.com, Elena Martinez <elena@wavebank.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + procurement next steps (WaveBank)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the summary — this aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications from procurement: 

1) I attached our vendor onboarding form (see attached) — please complete and return.
2) Standard payment term is Net30; we do issue POs. Ideally we get a signed MSA + onboarding packet, then we issue a PO referencing the MSA and the initial SOW.
3) For invoicing: please email invoices to procurement@wavebank.com and cc ap@wavebank.com. Our AP team requires invoices to include the PO number, Redwood's tax ID, and wire details (we prefer wire).

One question: will Redwood accept a PO that references the MSA and an initial monthly invoice while the SOW is finalized? Our legal likes to have the MSA in place first but can reference it on the PO.

If you can return the onboarding form today and the signed MSA, I can push for PO issuance next week.

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
Procurement Manager | WaveBank
Sanjay.Rao@wavebank.com

---Attached by WaveBank: wavebank_vendor_onboarding_form.docx---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@wavebank.com>, procurement@wavebank.com

Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 08:31:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + procurement next steps (WaveBank)

Hi Sanjay — attaching our completed vendor onboarding form and the signed MSA (v1.2). 

Notes:
- We've completed the onboarding form fields you provided; if procurement needs any additional fields filled, let me know and we'll update immediately.
- Redwood accepts a PO that references the signed MSA for initial billing; we can invoice against the PO while the SOW (technical scope & pricing) is finalized. If WaveBank prefers, we can start with a trial invoice for the initial pilot month and then adjust once the SOW is fully signed.
- Invoices will include Redwood's tax ID and wire details — Neha, can you confirm bank details look good for WaveBank?

Security artifacts: Stephanie is sending SOC2/pen-test summary in a separate email (expected in ~2 hours).

Proposed next milestone: once PO is issued, we can provision sandbox credentials for the engineering team (access within 48 hours of PO receipt).

Thanks for moving this quickly — appreciate it.

Best,
Marissa
